name: EntraSync User Storage
description: Provides user storage settings for EntraSync.
project_description: Submodule of EntraSync. Provides the `user` EntraSyncStorage plugin (UserStorage), which turns each distilled Microsoft Entra user into a Drupal user account. It matches existing accounts by e-mail, creates new ones with a generated password, maps Entra properties to user fields, sets the username and active/blocked state, adds configured roles (additively), and can send the core admin-created welcome e-mail. Admin roles are only offered to editors who hold 'administer permissions', and admin roles already stored are preserved when a lesser-privileged editor saves the form. Accounts are blocked in Drupal when the Entra account is disabled. Requires the base entrasync module.
